architecture: v5 (architecture 5, re-root 2026-11-02: a new world, dataset, generator and shell in another client domain; a water company's trunk mains to flush before a 2027 relining re-routes a town's supply, each main judged against the highest flow it actually carried, the 2026 operated arrangements included)
slot_note: architecture 5 of the slot, re-rooted at stage 1 on 2026-11-02: architectures 1 to 3 were private-markets liquidity forecasts for a Swiss pension foundation (v1 retired on the client's rules, v2 landed on the portal, v3 spent at stage 4), architecture 4 an MMR catch-up chosen by measles' winter reproduction number (delivered 2026-10-14; its ask layer spent at the 2026-11-02 judge); architecture 5 moves to Energy Systems & Utilities, a water distribution network's asset condition, with a new world, dataset and shell
niche: a water-only company's network operations team deciding which trunk mains to flush before a six-month relining outage re-routes a town's supply in 2027, when each main's settled material is conditioned to the highest flow it has carried and the year's burst repairs and an earlier relining phase ran some mains far above anything the normal valve arrangement implies
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the district meters' UTC hours, reads the relining plan's valve changes and the asset register's normal arrangement, and applies the field's conditioning test (a main is disturbed only by flows above its own recent peak) to each main's 2026 flows built from the normal arrangement, flushes every main the relining raises (all six); flagging every main whose flow rises, or every main above its typical daily peak, also flushes all six; only the flows rebuilt through the valve operations log's 2026 arrangements show four of them already carried more than the relining will send them, leaving two to flush.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each trunk main's peak flow under the relining arrangement against the highest flow it has carried, the distribution engineer's test of whether a change of flow will mobilise the material layers that build up on a main's wall (the layers are conditioned to the greatest shear the main has seen, as discolouration research and practice treat them); with another field's nouns (a hospital's corridors, a warehouse's aisles) nothing is conditioned by a past peak, so the task stops making sense.
layer1: district meters logging hourly mean flows on UTC, against a valve operations log kept on the control room's local clock across both 2026 clock changes
trunk main flows that no meter records, built by mass balance from the district meters through the network's arrangement
an asset register holding each main's normal valve state, with interconnectors normally shut
valve operations logged by crews as closures and openings by valve number, a valve's main found through the valve register
turbidity monitors at district inlets logging every 15 minutes with gaps at maintenance visits
district meters replaced or re-scaled during the record, their logger series carrying a short gap
the relining plan's valve changes stated by valve number, the mains they open and shut found through the register
stakeholder_role: the network operations planner preparing the relining outage plan the operations desk signs off

spine.entity: one hour's mean flow into one district metered area

world.geography: England (the south Midlands, a fictional water-only company)

driver: A unit is disturbed only by a load above the highest it has already carried, so its threshold is the maximum of its own past load; the natural history of that load is rebuilt from the system's standing arrangement, but the system ran for weeks under temporary arrangements that only an operations log records, and those raised several units' maxima above anything the standing arrangement implies, so a threshold read from the standing arrangement flags units a planned change will not in fact disturb.
driver_concrete: Each trunk main's wall material is conditioned to the highest flow it has carried; the planner builds each main's 2026 flows from the district meters and the normal valve arrangement and flushes every main the T03 relining raises above its 2026 peak (six), but the valve operations log shows phase 1 of the relining programme (T06, April to June 2026) and the June and July 2026 T04 bursts routed extra districts through T05, T08, T09 and X02 at flows the relining will not reach, which the district turbidity monitors confirm (no rise when those mains' summer peaks passed their normal-arrangement highs), so only T13 and X04 need flushing.
stump: Building each trunk main's 2026 flows from the district meters and the normal valve arrangement and flushing every main the Hollins Lane relining sends above its own 2026 peak names all six mains the relining raises; the step that lands it there is reading each main's conditioning off the arrangement on paper, when the valve operations log shows the 2026 phase 1 relining and the June and July bursts ran four of them at flows the relining will not reach, so only two need flushing.

differentiation.task445: task445 v2 completed a recent window's count for deaths a second body still held out of the register, linking that body's log on personal identifiers (a count completed); here nothing is counted or completed: each trunk main's conditioning threshold is the highest flow it actually carried, rebuilt from the valve operations log's temporary arrangements through the network, and the decision is which mains a forward flow change will lift above that threshold

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-11: decisive stump was a hidden recycling term recovered from audited cells, data semantics under the client's 10/10 rules
lineage.driver: The forward draw on a book of open commitments is each unit's age rate applied to its size and capped at what remains undrawn, and what remains undrawn is restored by the proceeds of any holding sold within a fixed time of its purchase, up to the original size, a rule stated nowhere and recovered only because the certified year-end balances reproduce under plain size-minus-draws for every unit that had no quick sale and fail for the ones that did; the months since the last certified year-end carry a run of quick sales far larger than any closed year, so carrying the certified balances forward net of draws, or rebuilding them from draws alone, leaves the cap biting on units that in fact have room and under-sizes the forward draw.

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-11: walk-forward selection with filed mechanics, both portal responses executed it and landed the call
lineage.driver: The forward figure is struck from whichever of several candidate pacing bases survives a walk-forward test on the closed years, with every rate re-estimated at each origin from the record before that origin and the facility sized at the plan plus the largest miss of the test; fitting once on the whole window and scoring the past with it crowns the richest base and understates the miss, so the easy validation lands two tranches short while every definition and rule in the pack is read correctly.

lineage.fate: replaced on paper at the 2026-10-12 redesign, before any portal test: the plan was the directive's filed walk-forward (rule application, the step both v2 portal responses executed), and the buffer's estimand was filed in s.5.6 ('at any point in a horizon'), a readable rung under the readability screen
lineage.driver: The facility covers a cumulative path through the year, so the buffer the validation sets is the furthest realised calls ran ahead of the forecast at any point inside a test horizon; the error table a solver builds is on horizon totals, and reading the buffer off it lands a tranche short, because calls cluster in the first half of each year while every candidate spreads them evenly, with the filed walk-forward and the filed recycling term executed correctly on both paths.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-12 at stage 4: judge pass 1 NOT_DETERMINISTIC on margin (an unfiled fit window gave CHF 200 million); after the repair, pass 2 found the remaining funds' call-rate base (on unfunded commitment, 329 and CHF 225 million, against on commitment, 349 and CHF 250 million) unseparated by anything filed; two failed passes spend the architecture
lineage.driver: A unit's forward draw on what remains of its allotment is set by how much it must still place before a hard deadline, because every unit whose deadline has passed had placed all but a small reserve by it whatever its earlier pace; a draw rate pooled by age over units that kept to schedule gives a group that fell behind and meets its deadline inside the window the same modest share as any unit of its age, and understates the window's total.

lineage.fate: shipped 2026-10-12, judged weak by the 10/10 audit on 2026-10-13: the decisive step was the next-generation matrix itself, a textbook reflex for a pack shipping a contact matrix whose only use was that method; the leak reader and the re-judge both built it unprompted and named B, and every textbook variant of the eigenvalue landed the call; round 2 keeps the world and moves the decisive step to the season the matrix is built for
lineage.driver: Whether a structured population can sustain a chain process is set by the dominant eigenvalue of its who-passes-to-whom matrix, so removing propensity from the subgroup that mixes most densely within itself can pull the system below its threshold while the system-average propensity, a contact-weighted average, the least-protected subgroup and the subgroup holding the most unprotected members all say the system is already below it or point at a subgroup whose removal leaves it above.

lineage.architecture: v4 round 2 (a regional health authority's autumn 2027 MMR catch-up, measles' winter reproduction number from the next-generation matrix built from the term-time contact diaries)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 on the ask layer: the call stayed sound (all six reproduction numbers forced at every judge pass), but every register device the world could carry died; the last two at the pass 4 judge (SEND_BACK, cut 84e4046b): dates of birth keyed a decade low read as held, and a twin's same-day second GP line read as an invalid second dose under the filed 28-day rule, each holding only on a rule no file states; re-rooted the same day to architecture 5 in another client domain, world, dataset and shell
lineage.niche: a regional health authority's department of public health choosing which birth cohort its one autumn 2027 MMR catch-up targets, or none, so that measles cannot keep spreading in winter 2027-28, when the cohort whose uptake fell in a 2010-12 vaccine scare is aged 15-19, and the national contact survey's public use file kept two thirds of its diaries in the school summer holidays, when teenagers' contacts with each other collapse
lineage.driver: Whether a structured population can sustain a chain process through a coming season is set by the dominant eigenvalue of its who-passes-to-whom matrix under the conditions that season runs in, and the only measurement of the matrix pools observation days from two regimes, one in which the subgroup holding a large unprotected share passes mostly within itself and one, the larger share of the days, in which it does not; the pooled matrix and every textbook treatment of it put the system below its threshold, as do the system-average and contact-weighted propensities, while the matrix rebuilt from the days under the season's own regime puts it above and points at that subgroup.
lineage.driver_concrete: On 1 January 2028 the region is 95.2 per cent immune, above the 93.3 per cent measles at R0 15 needs, so R0 times the susceptible share is 0.7, and the next-generation matrix built from all 7,560 diaries of the National Social Contact Survey 2023 gives 0.9; but 5,040 of those diaries were kept from 3 July to 18 August 2023, with the schools closed, when 15 to 19-year-olds have under a fifth of their contacts with each other against more than half in the May term diaries, and the winter runs in term; built from the term-time diaries the reproduction number is 1.3, and only the catch-up for those born 2008-12, 11.2 per cent susceptible, brings it below one (0.9), while D and E, the least immune cohort and the most people made immune, leave it at 1.3.
lineage.stump: A competent solver builds the next-generation matrix from every diary in the National Social Contact Survey's public use file, scales it to R0 15 and puts measles' reproduction number at 0.9 without a catch-up, so files that no catch-up is needed; the step that lands it there is pooling the 5,040 diaries kept from 3 July to 18 August 2023, in the school summer holidays, with the 2,520 kept in May term time, when the winter's transmission runs on term-time contacts: built from the term-time diaries the reproduction number is 1.3 and only the catch-up for those born 2008-2012 brings it below one (0.9).
